phase3_findings.description: test_qualified_and_uppercase_calls_refused now has only the unqualified SELECT GET_LOCK('a', 1) row; the diff deleted every schema-qualified denylist case and ported none to mysql or no dialect, so no test checks that a <schema>.<denied_fn>(...) call is refused and the test name claims coverage it lacks.
DatabaseConfig.url scheme validator runs only at construction; no validate_assignment, so later assignment or model_copy(update=...) skips it. No src caller does this today.

Downstream code keeps a looser startswith("mysql") scheme test than the validator: build_sql_runner (factory.py:250), probe_database (preflight.py:116) and sqlglot_dialect_for_url (readonly.py:187) accept mysqlx:// when called directly.
_SQLGLOT_DIALECT_MAP still maps mssql and mariadb, which config loading now refuses; dead entries, and mariadb reads as unsupported compatibility.

_refuse_database_routines lost its dialect parameter and always sends a MySQL information_schema.ROUTINES query; correct only because its single caller gates on dialect == "mysql" (line 112), an unstated precondition.

preflight.py docstring (and docs/internal/setup/preflight.md:47) names only the character-set statement the MySQL driver's connect sends; PyMySQL also sends SET AUTOCOMMIT = 0. The main 'no SQL of its own' claim holds.
test_sql_runner_cleanup.py still raises and matches _PrimaryError("max_statement_time exceeded"), the MariaDB variable name, while nearby text now says MAX_EXECUTION_TIME.
docs/internal/index.md row names one MySQL SqlRunner implementation but keeps plural pronouns ('they log when they do').
